title: How AI is changing the vulnerability response timeline
summary: AI is transforming how security researchers analyze code, trace suspicious behavior, and identify vulnerabilities that traditional tools miss. The article focuses on zero-day vulnerability response, examining how container composition, dependency records, and rebuild speed impact security teams after unknown flaws are discovered.
problem_solved: Accelerates the detection and response to zero-day vulnerabilities that conventional security tools overlook
why_valuable: Enables security teams to respond faster to critical vulnerabilities, reducing the window of exposure and potential damage from attacks
